title: Szalámitaktika és kékcédulás választások (Liquidation of Democracy (1945–1948))
grammar: Authoritarian Mechanics, Totalitarian Discourse & State Terror Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain how the communists removed the opposition parties one by one between 1945 and 1948.
I can say what the blue-slip election of 1947 was.
I can say which party won the free election of 1945.
I can use six words about the takeover, such as szalámitaktika and koalíciós kormány.
